newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch consumer confidence rises in January.
newsitem.headline: Dutch consumer confidence rises in January.

text.p: The Dutch consumer confidence index rose to 12.0 in January from 1.0 in December, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said.
The CBS said an improvement of consumer confidence was not unusual in January, but added it was the biggest January increase in ten years.
The CBS said the overall index measuring the opinion on the general economic climate also rose, going up from six in December to 18 in January.
"The underlying movement of this indicator has been pointing at an increasing confidence since the spring of 1996," CBS said.
The other sub-index, which makes up the overall index and which measures consumers' feelings about their personal financial situation and spending plans, rose ten points.
It increased from minus two in December to plus eight in January.
The CBS said the rise in this indicator was mainly due to seasonal factors.
